webhooks.name: InferenceGraphValidator-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Validates InferenceGraph resources on create and update by enforcing naming conventions (lowercase alphanumeric with dashes), requiring a 'root' node, ensuring step names are unique within each node, verifying each step targets exactly one of nodeName/serviceName/serviceURL, and checking that splitter nodes have weights summing to 100.

webhooks.name: InferenceServiceDefaulter-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Mutating webhook that sets defaults on InferenceService resources during create/update. It reads cluster configuration to apply default resource requirements, deployment modes, runtime/serving framework assignments (SKLearn, TensorFlow, Triton, etc.), protocol versions, security settings (disabling service account token automount), and local model cache labels/annotations by matching the InferenceService's storage URI against LocalModelCache and LocalModelNamespaceCache resources.

webhooks.name: InferenceServiceValidator-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Validates InferenceService resources on create and update by enforcing naming conventions, autoscaler configuration, blocked environment variables, multi-node/worker-spec constraints, storage URI correctness, predictor framework rules, and per-component autoscaling extension settings (HPA/KPA/KEDA metrics and targets) to ensure only well-formed serving specs are admitted.

webhooks.name: LocalModelCacheValidator-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Validates LocalModelCache resources on create, update, and delete. On create/update, it enforces that no two LocalModelCache resources share the same storageURI. On delete, it prevents removal if the LocalModelCache is still referenced by any InferenceService or LLMInferenceService.

webhooks.name: LocalModelNamespaceCacheValidator-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Validates LocalModelNamespaceCache resources on create, update, and delete. On create/update, it ensures all referenced NodeGroups exist. On delete, it prevents removal if the cache is still referenced by any InferenceService or LLMInferenceService via label matching.

webhooks.name: TrainedModelValidator-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Validates TrainedModel resources on create and update, ensuring the model name matches an alphanumeric/underscore/hyphen pattern, the storageURI uses a supported protocol prefix, and the memory specification is not modified after initial creation.

webhooks.name: clusterservingruntime.kserve-webhook-server.validator
webhooks.purpose: Validates ServingRuntime and ClusterServingRuntime resources on create/update to prevent model format priority conflicts (no two runtimes sharing the same protocol may assign the same priority to the same model format, and a single runtime must use consistent priorities for the same format), enforces multi-node WorkerSpec constraints (parallel size minimums, single-container limit, GPU type validation, disallowed env vars, no removal of existing workerSpec), and blocks reserved environment variables in containers.

webhooks.name: inferenceservice.kserve-webhook-server.pod-mutator
webhooks.purpose: Mutates Pods created for KServe InferenceServices by injecting storage initializer containers (for model downloading), agent sidecars (for logging, batching, and request routing), metrics aggregator sidecars, credential volumes/env-vars for accessing model storage (S3, GCS, Azure, etc.), GKE GPU accelerator node selectors, Istio CNI security contexts, and OCI modelcar init containers. It reads cluster configuration and the owning InferenceService to determine which sidecars, credentials, and init containers to inject.

webhooks.name: llminferenceservice.kserve-webhook-server.v1alpha1.defaulter
webhooks.purpose: Mutating defaulter that applies defaults to LLMInferenceService resources and attaches local model cache labels and annotations by matching the service's model URI against cluster-scoped LocalModelCache and namespace-scoped LocalModelNamespaceCache entries (namespace-scoped takes precedence), enabling the controller to bind the correct local model PVC for cached model serving.

webhooks.name: llminferenceservice.kserve-webhook-server.v1alpha1.validator
webhooks.purpose: Validating webhook for LLMInferenceService v1alpha1 resources on create and update. It enforces router cross-field constraints (e.g., HTTPRoute refs vs inline spec exclusivity, managed-gateway compatibility), parallelism constraints (data/pipeline parallelism mutual exclusivity, worker requires parallelism), scheduler config validity (replicas > 0, inline/ref mutual exclusivity), workload scaling rules, actuator backend consistency across decode and prefill workloads, and immutability of total parallelism size on updates.

webhooks.name: llminferenceservice.kserve-webhook-server.v1alpha2.defaulter
webhooks.purpose: Mutating defaulter that applies defaults to LLMInferenceService resources and attaches local model cache labels and annotations by matching the service's model URI against cluster-scoped LocalModelCache and namespace-scoped LocalModelNamespaceCache entries (namespace-scoped takes precedence), enabling the controller to bind the correct local model PVC for cached model serving.

webhooks.name: llminferenceservice.kserve-webhook-server.v1alpha2.validator
webhooks.purpose: Validates LLMInferenceService v1alpha2 resources on create and update, enforcing router/HTTPRoute cross-field constraints, parallelism configuration rules (pipeline vs data exclusivity, worker requires parallelism), parallelism size immutability on updates, scheduler config consistency (inline vs ref, replicas > 0), LoRA adapter naming uniqueness and safety, and autoscaling invariants (replicas vs scaling exclusivity, min/max bounds, HPA/KEDA mutual exclusivity, decode/prefill actuator consistency, KEDA controller-owned field restrictions, and variantCost format).

webhooks.name: llminferenceserviceconfig.kserve-webhook-server.v1alpha1.validator
webhooks.purpose: Validates LLMInferenceServiceConfig resources on create and update, rejecting configs that use the forbidden baseRefs field (recursive refs are disabled) or specify invalid scheduler replicas (must be >0), and emits warnings when well-known configs are modified or deleted.

webhooks.name: llminferenceserviceconfig.kserve-webhook-server.v1alpha2.validator
webhooks.purpose: Validates LLMInferenceServiceConfig resources on create and update, rejecting configs that use the forbidden baseRefs field or specify invalid scheduler replicas (<= 0), and emitting warnings when well-known (built-in) configs are modified or deleted.

webhooks.name: servingruntime.kserve-webhook-server.validator
webhooks.purpose: Validates ServingRuntime and ClusterServingRuntime resources on create/update to prevent model format priority conflicts (no two runtimes sharing the same protocol may assign the same priority to the same model format, and a single runtime must use consistent priorities for the same format), enforces multi-node WorkerSpec constraints (parallel size minimums, single-container limit, GPU type validation, disallowed env vars, no removal of existing workerSpec), and blocks reserved environment variables in containers.

webhooks.name: clusterservingruntime.kserve-webhook-server.validator
webhooks.purpose: Validates ServingRuntime and ClusterServingRuntime resources on create/update to enforce model format priority uniqueness across runtimes sharing the same protocol, consistency of priority values within a single runtime, multi-node WorkerSpec constraints (single container, no removal of existing WorkerSpec, valid parallel sizes, known GPU types), and blocked environment variables.

webhooks.name: inferenceservice.kserve-webhook-server.pod-mutator
webhooks.purpose: Mutating admission webhook for Pods created by KServe InferenceServices. It injects storage initializer init-containers (with credential mounting), inference logger/batcher agent sidecars, metrics aggregator sidecars, GKE accelerator node selectors, and OCI storage support into model-serving pods at creation time.

webhooks.name: llminferenceservice.kserve-webhook-server.v1alpha1.defaulter
webhooks.purpose: Mutating defaulter that applies defaults to LLMInferenceService resources and, when local model caching is enabled in the inference service ConfigMap, matches the service's model URI against existing LocalModelNamespaceCache (namespace-scoped, higher priority) and LocalModelCache (cluster-scoped) resources to set labels and annotations identifying the matching cache and its PVC for local model serving.

webhooks.name: llminferenceservice.kserve-webhook-server.v1alpha1.validator
webhooks.purpose: Validating admission webhook for LLMInferenceService v1alpha1 that enforces structural constraints on create and update: mutual exclusivity of HTTPRoute refs vs inline spec, gateway managed/custom consistency, traffic-splitting fields (group and weight must be paired and require Gateway API routing), parallelism rules (worker requires parallelism, pipeline and data parallelism are mutually exclusive, data/dataLocal must be set together, all values positive), scheduler config (replicas positive, inline vs ref mutually exclusive), scaling validation (delegated to v1alpha2), and immutability of total parallelism size on updates.

webhooks.name: llminferenceservice.kserve-webhook-server.v1alpha2.defaulter
webhooks.purpose: Mutating defaulter that applies defaults to LLMInferenceService resources and, when local model caching is enabled in the inference service ConfigMap, matches the service's model URI against existing LocalModelNamespaceCache (namespace-scoped, higher priority) and LocalModelCache (cluster-scoped) resources to set labels and annotations identifying the matching cache and its PVC for local model serving.

webhooks.name: llminferenceservice.kserve-webhook-server.v1alpha2.validator
webhooks.purpose: Validating admission webhook for LLMInferenceService v1alpha2 that rejects invalid create/update requests by enforcing cross-field constraints on router and Gateway API routing, parallelism (pipeline vs data, immutability of size on update), scaling (min/max replicas, WVA actuator exclusivity between HPA and KEDA, decode/prefill actuator consistency, KEDA idle-replica rules, variantCost format), LoRA adapter names (uniqueness, path-traversal, base-model collision), KV-cache offloading tier configuration, managed DRA annotation completeness and format, scheduler config mutual exclusivity, traffic-splitting prerequisites, and confidential model spec correctness.

webhooks.name: llminferenceserviceconfig.kserve-webhook-server.v1alpha1.validator
webhooks.purpose: Validates LLMInferenceServiceConfig resources on create, update, and delete. Rejects configs that set the forbidden baseRefs field or specify non-positive scheduler replicas, warns (or blocks) modifications and deletions of well-known configs, and runs an optional injected validation function for controller-level checks.

webhooks.name: llminferenceserviceconfig.kserve-webhook-server.v1alpha2.validator
webhooks.purpose: Validates LLMInferenceServiceConfig resources on create, update, and delete. Enforces that baseRefs is not used (recursive refs disabled), scheduler replicas are positive if set, runs optional injected validation logic, and warns or blocks modification/deletion of well-known configs.

webhooks.name: servingruntime.kserve-webhook-server.validator
webhooks.purpose: Validates ServingRuntime and ClusterServingRuntime resources on create/update to enforce model format priority uniqueness across runtimes sharing the same protocol, consistency of priority values within a single runtime, multi-node WorkerSpec constraints (single container, no removal of existing WorkerSpec, valid parallel sizes, known GPU types), and blocked environment variables.

webhooks.name: notebooks-validation.opendatahub.io
webhooks.purpose: Validates updates to Notebook resources, specifically preventing removal of the MLflow instance annotation while a notebook is running. This guards against a broken state where the MLflow RoleBinding would be deleted immediately but environment variables would persist until pod restart, leaving the MLflow client with credentials but no permissions.

webhooks.name: notebooks.opendatahub.io
webhooks.purpose: Mutating admission webhook for Kubeflow Notebook CRs (create/update) that injects operational sidecars and configuration: a kube-rbac-proxy authentication sidecar with TLS, cluster-wide proxy environment variables, trusted CA certificate bundles, pipeline runtime image mounts, Elyra/Data Science Pipelines config secrets, MLflow tracking environment variables, and container image resolution from OpenShift ImageStreams. It also prevents webhook-only mutations from restarting running notebook pods by blocking spec changes and marking them as pending updates until the notebook is stopped or restarted.

webhooks.name: mraycluster.kb.io
webhooks.purpose: Mutating webhook that defaults RayCluster resources on create/update: on OpenShift clusters it enforces secure trusted networking by setting the EnableSecureTrustedNetwork annotation to true and forcibly disables EnableIngress (Route/Ingress creation) to enforce Gateway-API-only access with centralized authentication; on non-OpenShift clusters it sets the annotation to false.

webhooks.name: mraycluster.kb.io
webhooks.purpose: Mutating webhook that defaults RayCluster resources on create/update: on OpenShift clusters it enforces secure trusted networking by setting the EnableSecureTrustedNetwork annotation to true and forcibly disables EnableIngress (Route/Ingress creation) to enforce Gateway-API-only access with centralized authentication; on non-OpenShift clusters it sets the annotation to false.

webhooks.name: vraycluster.kb.io
webhooks.purpose: Validates RayCluster resources on create and update by checking that the cluster metadata name is valid (via ValidateRayClusterMetadata) and that all worker group names within the spec are unique, rejecting the admission request if either constraint is violated.

webhooks.name: vrayjob.kb.io
webhooks.purpose: Validating admission webhook for RayJob resources that rejects create and update requests whose metadata (specifically the object name) fails RayJob-specific naming rules, ensuring RayJob names are valid before they are persisted.

webhooks.name: vrayservice.kb.io
webhooks.purpose: Validating webhook for RayService resources that rejects create and update requests whose metadata (specifically the object name) fails RayService-specific naming constraints enforced by ValidateRayServiceMetadata.

webhooks.name: mmodelregistry.opendatahub.io
webhooks.purpose: Registers mutating and validating admission webhooks for ModelRegistry custom resources. The mutating webhook sets defaults (service route, database config cleanup, OAuth-to-kube-rbac-proxy migration, and kube-rbac-proxy defaults on OpenShift), while the validating webhook enforces that the namespace matches the configured registries namespace, at least one database backend is configured, and the registry name is unique cluster-wide.

webhooks.name: vmodelregistry.opendatahub.io
webhooks.purpose: Registers mutating and validating admission webhooks for ModelRegistry custom resources. The mutating webhook sets defaults (service route, database config cleanup, OAuth-to-kube-rbac-proxy migration, and kube-rbac-proxy defaults on OpenShift), while the validating webhook enforces that the namespace matches the configured registries namespace, at least one database backend is configured, and the registry name is unique cluster-wide.

webhooks.name: vaitenant.kb.io
webhooks.purpose: Validating webhook for AITenant resources that enforces two invariants: (1) AITenant CRs may only be created in the configured infrastructure namespace, and (2) each AITenant must reference a unique Gateway — no two AITenants may share the same Gateway namespace/name pair, ensuring tenant isolation.

webhooks.name: vmaasauthpolicy.kb.io
webhooks.purpose: Validating webhook for MaaSAuthPolicy resources on creation. It ensures the target namespace is an authorized MaaS tenant namespace by checking that a MaasTenantConfig (or legacy Tenant) CR exists in that namespace, rejecting creation if the namespace has not been properly initialized for tenant resources.

webhooks.name: vmaassubscription.kb.io
webhooks.purpose: Validating webhook for MaaSSubscription creation that ensures the target namespace is enabled for MaaS tenant resources. It rejects creation unless a MaasTenantConfig (or legacy Tenant) CR already exists in the same namespace, enforcing proper tenant initialization before subscriptions can be created.

webhooks.name: connection-llmisvc-v1alpha1.odh-model-controller.opendatahub.io
webhooks.purpose: Mutating admission webhook for LLMInferenceService resources (v1alpha1 and v1alpha2). It injects ConnectionsAPI credentials (S3 serviceAccountName and model URI, OCI imagePullSecrets, or plain URI) into the spec based on a connection annotation on the resource, and applies HardwareProfile scheduling stanzas (container resources, nodeSelector, tolerations, Kueue queue label) from a referenced HardwareProfile CR. On updates it handles connection replacement/removal cleanup and surgical removal of previously-injected HardwareProfile values.

webhooks.name: connection-llmisvc-v1alpha2.odh-model-controller.opendatahub.io
webhooks.purpose: Mutating admission webhook for LLMInferenceService resources (v1alpha1 and v1alpha2). It injects ConnectionsAPI credentials (S3 serviceAccountName and model URI, OCI imagePullSecrets, or plain URI) into the spec based on a connection annotation on the resource, and applies HardwareProfile scheduling stanzas (container resources, nodeSelector, tolerations, Kueue queue label) from a referenced HardwareProfile CR. On updates it handles connection replacement/removal cleanup and surgical removal of previously-injected HardwareProfile values.

webhooks.name: minferencegraph-v1alpha1.odh-model-controller.opendatahub.io
webhooks.purpose: Provides mutating defaults and validating admission control for KServe InferenceGraph v1alpha1 resources. The validator enforces that serviceURL references in graph node steps use only cluster-internal hostnames (.svc or .svc.<clusterDomain>) within the same namespace as the InferenceGraph, rejecting public hostnames and cross-namespace references to prevent data leakage (e.g. Authorization header) and enforce network security boundaries.

webhooks.name: minferenceservice-v1beta1.odh-model-controller.opendatahub.io
webhooks.purpose: Mutating and validating admission webhook for KServe InferenceService resources. The validating webhook rejects creation when the name exceeds length limits or targets the protected applications namespace (from DSCInitialization). The mutating webhook injects connection credentials (S3 storage keys, URI storageUri, OCI imagePullSecrets) and HardwareProfile scheduling stanzas (container resources, nodeSelector, tolerations, Kueue queue label) into the InferenceService spec based on annotations, and surgically cleans up previously-injected values on connection or profile removal.

webhooks.name: mutating.pod.odh-model-controller.opendatahub.io
webhooks.purpose: Mutates incoming Pods that have RAY_USE_TLS enabled (in kserve-container or worker-container) by injecting TLS volumes, volume mounts, and an init container that copies Ray TLS certificates from a shared Secret into the pod, enabling mTLS communication between Ray cluster nodes used for distributed inference serving.

webhooks.name: validating.isvc.odh-model-controller.opendatahub.io
webhooks.purpose: Mutating and validating admission webhook for KServe InferenceService resources. The validating webhook rejects creation when the name exceeds length limits or targets the protected applications namespace (from DSCInitialization). The mutating webhook injects connection credentials (S3 storage keys, URI storageUri, OCI imagePullSecrets) and HardwareProfile scheduling stanzas (container resources, nodeSelector, tolerations, Kueue queue label) into the InferenceService spec based on annotations, and surgically cleans up previously-injected values on connection or profile removal.

webhooks.name: validating.nim.account.odh-model-controller.opendatahub.io
webhooks.purpose: Validates NIM Account creation by enforcing a singleton constraint: only one Account resource is allowed per namespace. On create, it lists existing Accounts in the target namespace and rejects the request if one already exists; updates and deletes are always permitted.

webhooks.name: vinferencegraph-v1alpha1.odh-model-controller.opendatahub.io
webhooks.purpose: Provides mutating defaults and validating admission control for KServe InferenceGraph v1alpha1 resources. The validator enforces that serviceURL references in graph node steps use only cluster-internal hostnames (.svc or .svc.<clusterDomain>) within the same namespace as the InferenceGraph, rejecting public hostnames and cross-namespace references to prevent data leakage (e.g. Authorization header) and enforce network security boundaries.

webhooks.name: vogxserver.kb.io
webhooks.purpose: Validating webhook for OGXServer create/update that rejects unknown distribution names, duplicate provider IDs, model-to-provider references pointing to non-existent providers, and self-referencing adoption annotations (where the adoption annotation value equals the CR name). It also warns when a deprecated distribution name is used.

webhooks.name: Defaulter-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Mutating webhook that sets default field values on DataScienceCluster v2 resources during create/update. Specifically, when ModelRegistry is Managed it defaults RegistriesNamespace to the canonical namespace, and when Kserve is Managed it defaults the NIM sub-component ManagementState to Managed.

webhooks.name: Defaulter-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Mutating webhook that sets default field values on DataScienceCluster v1 resources during create/update. Specifically, when ModelRegistry is Managed and RegistriesNamespace is empty it sets the default registries namespace, and when Kserve is Managed and NIM ManagementState is empty it defaults NIM to Managed.

webhooks.name: Injector-webhook
webhooks.enable_condition: MonitoringServiceName component enabled OR MonitoringServiceName component enabled
webhooks.purpose: Mutating admission webhook that automatically injects the monitoring scrape label (monitoring.opendatahub.io/scrape=true) onto PodMonitor and ServiceMonitor resources created or updated in namespaces labeled for ODH monitoring, after verifying that the cluster-scoped Monitoring CR exists (i.e., monitoring is enabled).

webhooks.name: Injector-webhook
webhooks.enable_condition: Kserve component enabled OR Workbenches component enabled
webhooks.purpose: Mutating admission webhook that intercepts create/update of Notebooks, InferenceServices, and LLMInferenceServices to inject hardware profile settings (resource requests/limits, node selectors, tolerations) from a referenced HardwareProfile CR. It detects profile changes or removals to clear stale settings, merges scheduling constraints, and emits warning events when container names don't match expectations.

webhooks.name: NotebookWebhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Mutating webhook for Kubeflow Notebook CRs that validates the 'opendatahub.io/connections' annotation on create/update. It verifies each referenced Secret exists in the Notebook's namespace, confirms the requesting user has 'get' permission on those Secrets via SubjectAccessReview, then mutates the Notebook's first container to inject (or remove) envFrom secretRef entries so connection Secrets are automatically available as environment variables.

webhooks.name: Validator-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Validates DSCInitialization v1 resources to enforce singleton creation (only one instance allowed), validates PEM format of customCABundle when TrustedCABundle is Managed, and prevents deletion while any DataScienceCluster object still exists.

webhooks.name: Validator-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Validates DSCInitialization v2 resources by enforcing singleton creation (only one instance allowed), rejecting deletion when a DataScienceCluster still exists, and validating that any customCABundle contains well-formed PEM certificates when TrustedCABundle is Managed.

webhooks.name: Validator-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Validates DataScienceCluster v1 create and update requests: enforces singleton creation (only one DSC instance allowed), denies Kueue with Managed state, prevents v1 API updates when v2-only components are Managed to avoid silent data loss during v1-to-v2 conversion, and warns about the deprecated kserve.modelsAsService field.

webhooks.name: Validator-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Validates DataScienceCluster v2 create and update requests: enforces a singleton constraint (only one DSC instance allowed), denies Kueue component with ManagementState 'Managed' (no longer supported), and emits a deprecation warning when the kserve.modelsAsService field is set to Managed.

webhooks.name: mutate-pod.sparkoperator.k8s.io
webhooks.purpose: Mutating admission webhook that intercepts Pod creation requests in Spark job namespaces, looks up the owning SparkApplication by label, and defaults the pod spec with settings from the SparkApplication CR—including volumes, volume mounts, env vars, config maps (Spark/Hadoop/general), Prometheus config, container ports, affinity, tolerations, node selectors, DNS config, scheduler name, priority class, security contexts, sidecar/init containers, GPU resources, host networking, termination grace period, lifecycle hooks, host aliases, share-process-namespace, owner references, and memory limits.

webhooks.name: mutate-scheduledsparkapplication.sparkoperator.k8s.io
webhooks.purpose: Mutating admission webhook that sets default values on ScheduledSparkApplication resources during create and update operations. Currently a no-op placeholder that only logs the mutation request; concrete defaulting logic is deferred to a future implementation.

webhooks.name: mutate-sparkapplication.sparkoperator.k8s.io
webhooks.purpose: Mutating webhook that sets default values on SparkApplication resources during create and update operations. It only applies defaults when the application is in a 'New' or 'Invalidating' state, delegating to the operator's scheme-level defaulting logic to populate unset fields.

webhooks.name: mutate-sparkconnect.sparkoperator.k8s.io
webhooks.purpose: Mutating webhook that sets default field values on SparkConnect resources during create and update operations by applying the registered scheme defaults, ensuring all required fields have sensible values before the object is persisted.

webhooks.name: validate-scheduledsparkapplication.sparkoperator.k8s.io
webhooks.purpose: Validates ScheduledSparkApplication resources on create and update, ensuring the metadata.name is a valid DNS-1035 label (to prevent downstream Service/SparkApplication creation failures from invalid names) and that the embedded SparkConf configuration is valid. On updates, validation is skipped if the spec has not changed.

webhooks.name: validate-sparkapplication.sparkoperator.k8s.io
webhooks.purpose: Validating admission webhook for SparkApplication resources on create and update. It enforces that the app name is a valid DNS-1035 label, prevents conflicting NodeSelector definitions at both the app and driver/executor levels, validates DriverIngressOptions for uniqueness, checks Spark version compatibility for pod templates, validates SparkConf, and optionally enforces that the application's resource requests fit within the namespace's ResourceQuotas.

webhooks.name: validate-sparkconnect.sparkoperator.k8s.io
webhooks.purpose: Validating webhook for SparkConnect resources on create and update. It enforces that the resource name is a valid DNS-1035 label (short enough for the derived '-server' Service name), requires a sparkVersion (>= 3.0.0 when pod templates are used), ensures a container image is specified either at the spec level or in both server and executor pod templates, validates dynamic-allocation executor bounds (min <= initial <= max, all non-negative), checks server/executor memory string formats, and validates sparkConf entries.

webhooks.name: ClusterTrainingRuntimeWebhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Validating webhook for ClusterTrainingRuntime resources that enforces correctness of replicatedJobs in the runtime spec on create and update, and emits a deprecation warning if the runtime is labeled as deprecated.

webhooks.name: TrainJobWebhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Validating webhook for TrainJob resources that intercepts create and update requests, resolving the TrainJob's runtimeRef to a registered runtime implementation and delegating validation logic to that runtime's ValidateObjects method. It rejects requests that reference an unsupported runtime.

webhooks.name: TrainingRuntimeWebhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Validates TrainingRuntime resources on create to ensure that replicated jobs marked with ancestor labels (trainer, model-initializer, dataset-initializer) have exactly 1 replica and contain the required named container for that ancestor role.

webhooks.name: Webhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Validating webhook for TFJob resources that enforces structural correctness on create and update: ensures the job name is a valid DNS-1035 label, requires TFReplicaSpecs with at least one container named 'tensorflow' per replica that has an image set, forbids more than one Chief/Master replica type, and validates RunPolicy fields (including immutability checks on update).

webhooks.name: Webhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Validating webhook for XGBoostJob resources that enforces structural correctness on create and update: ensures the job name is a valid DNS-1035 label, requires a Master replica type with exactly one replica, restricts replica types to Master and Worker, mandates that every replica spec has at least one container with a non-empty image and one container named 'xgboost', and validates the RunPolicy (including immutability checks on update).

webhooks.name: Webhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Validating webhook for JAXJob resources that enforces structural correctness on create and update: it checks the job name is a valid DNS-1035 label, ensures jaxReplicaSpecs is present with only the 'Worker' replica type, and validates that each replica spec contains at least one container with a non-empty image and a container named 'jax'.

webhooks.name: Webhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Validating webhook for PaddleJob resources that enforces naming conventions (DNS-1035 labels), run policy constraints, and spec correctness on create and update. It ensures replica types are only Master or Worker, that each replica spec has containers with images defined, and that a default container named "paddle" is present.

webhooks.name: Webhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Validating webhook for PyTorchJob resources that enforces structural correctness on create and update: the job name must be a DNS-1035 label, replica types must be Master (exactly 1 replica) or Worker (at least 1 replica), each replica spec must contain at least one container named 'pytorch' with a non-empty image, elastic policy requires a Worker spec and forbids using the deprecated elasticPolicy.nProcPerNode alongside spec.nprocPerNode, and RunPolicy fields are validated including immutability checks on update.

webhooks.name: connection-notebook.opendatahub.io
webhooks.purpose: Mutating admission webhook that intercepts Notebook create/update requests and injects connection secrets as envFrom entries into notebook containers. It parses the opendatahub.io/connections annotation (a comma-separated list of namespace/name secret references), validates that each referenced Secret exists and that the requesting user has permission to read it via SubjectAccessReview, then patches the notebook's container spec to add or remove secretRef envFrom entries based on the diff between old and new annotations.

webhooks.name: hardwareprofile-notebook-injector.opendatahub.io
webhooks.purpose: Mutating admission webhook that intercepts Notebook create/update requests and injects hardware profile settings (resource limits/requests, nodeSelector, tolerations) from a referenced HardwareProfile CR into the notebook pod template. On profile changes or removal, it cleans up previously applied settings so the notebook always reflects the currently selected hardware profile.

webhooks.name: localmodelnamespacecache.kserve-webhook-server.validator
webhooks.purpose: Validates LocalModelNamespaceCache resources on create, update, and delete. On create/update, it ensures all referenced NodeGroups exist; on delete, it prevents removal if the cache is still referenced by any InferenceService or LLMInferenceService (checked via label matching against the status-tracked service lists).

webhooks.name: vworkspace.kb.io
webhooks.purpose: Validating admission webhook for Workspace resources (kubeflow.org/v1beta1). On create and update, it fetches the referenced WorkspaceKind to verify it exists, then validates that the selected imageConfig and podConfig IDs are among the allowed values defined in that WorkspaceKind, and that pod metadata labels/annotations are well-formed.

webhooks.name: vworkspacekind.kb.io
webhooks.purpose: Validating webhook for WorkspaceKind resources (kubeflow.org/v1beta1) on create, update, and delete. On create/update it validates pod metadata labels/annotations, extra environment variables, request header templates, imageConfig and podConfig values (port references, redirect chains, cycle detection), and default selections; on update it also lazily queries Workspace usage counts to prevent removing or modifying options currently in use by active workspaces. On delete it blocks removal if any Workspaces reference the WorkspaceKind or if it still has a protection finalizer.
